analogy.rationale: Actin polymerization inhibitors disrupt the cytoskeleton and contractile machinery, overlapping functionally with microtubule/tubulin inhibitors and Rho-kinase inhibitors that control actin-myosin dynamics. Because the annotated targets (ACTA1, MKL1, SPIRE2) are cytoskeletal/contractile and not highly expressed in most of these cell lines, the overall transcriptional response is expected to be weak.
